The access port number of the node.

description.zh: 实例节点所在的可用区ID。例如，上海可用区C为cn-shanghai-c。
description.en: The zone ID of the instance node. For example, the ID of Zone C in the China (Shanghai) region is cn-shanghai-c.

description.zh:
节点类型，可选值：

- WORKER：热节点
- WORKER_WARM：冷节点

> 不支持COORDINATING（协调节点）和KIBANA（Kibana节点）。
description.en:
The node type. Valid values:

- WORKER: hot node
- WORKER_WARM: warm node

> COORDINATING (client node) and KIBANA (Kibana node) are not supported.

title.zh: 校验是否可以迁移实例中节点
title.en: Validate whether data on nodes in an instance can be migrated

example.unifiedCli: aliyun elasticsearch validate-transferable-nodes --instance-id es-cn-nif1q9o8r00080000 --node-type WORKER --biz-body port=9200 host=172.16.xx.xx zoneId=cn-shanghai-c --api-version 2017-06-13 --region cn-hangzhou
